patch.summary: Runway cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Runway pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: Runway cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Runway against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (enterprise admin and SSO (Free, Standard (annual), Pro (annual), Max (annual))) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (LLM chat and assistants, image generation, voice / text-to-speech) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Credits buy seconds of flagship video — Standard is not an unlimited studio. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Creators and agencies generating short AI video clips requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
